method: Built-in image_gen, precise-object-edit; approved MINERO reused unchanged

items.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a transparent portrait Kalistar closed grimoire cover, one of a coherent twelve-book collectible set.
Input 1: EDIT TARGET, the approved upright grey Minero book. Input 2: EXACT ELECTRO Kalistel emblem reference. This is one book only, not a contact sheet.

Change only the leather palette and lower-cover Kalistel identity:
- The leather on front cover, spine and small corner inset surfaces becomes rich muted amber-yellow / old golden leather, distinct from bronze fittings. Keep the same fine worn leather texture, subtle color planes and hand-painted premium material, not flat digital recoloring.
- Replace the lower Minero emblem with the exact ELECTRO identity from input 2: yellow-gold crystal with fine yellow electrical arcs. Keep the elongated double-point faceted silhouette and angular golden hexagonal setting. Reproduce the emblem's recognizable colors AND elemental interior motifs. The elemental energy stays restricted to the emblem interior; it does not invade the book edges or transparent background.
- Keep the lower emblem at EXACTLY the same size and position as on input 1, centered on the front face.

Invariants: do not change the book geometry, proportions or composition. Perfectly upright front-facing closed book, horizontal top/bottom, vertical edges, no tilt/yaw/skew/perspective. Retain the narrow LEFT spine, bottom page block, existing patinated bronze/gold corner fittings, ribs and filigree. Same painted fantasy Kalistar craftsmanship, visible tactile grain, relief and softly shaded metal. Upper and middle front face remains EMPTY for later live HTML title. No new carvings, new props, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, or environment.
Composition: isolated complete book, portrait 1024 x 1536, same transparent margins as input 1, fully visible and unclipped.
Background: genuine transparent alpha; no painted backdrop or checkerboard pixels.
